Use equal object scale across all five views.

families.name: Residential electric AMI meter module
families.spec: ONE isolated residential electric AMI meter module, no house and no wall segment. A compact vertically rectangular weatherproof matte-gray wall cabinet with a slightly overhanging top cap, a narrow dark back mounting plate, and TWO tiny mounting tabs visible above and below. FRONT is the face containing a single round ivory-and-gray electricity meter behind a circular clear cover in the upper two thirds; meter face has a small plain dark digital display with NO readable digits or lettering. Cabinet lower third is a plain rectangular access door with a tiny latch on its RIGHT edge. Exactly ONE slim gray conduit exits bottom center and ends after a short straight length. RIGHT side of cabinet has one tiny round sealed port near the bottom, LEFT side is plain. Rear face is the flat mounting plate with two screw slots and a central raised vertical channel. Show cabinet depth, correct oblique front faces in first two views, proper plain mounting back in rear views, and narrow rectangular cabinet top with meter bulge in overhead plan. Never place meter dial on rear surface. Detached freestanding module on transparent alpha.

families.name: Residential diaphragm gas meter module
families.spec: ONE isolated residential diaphragm gas meter and regulator module, no house and no wall segment. FRONT is the meter's reading face. Main meter is a squat rectangular matte-gray metal diaphragm gas meter with softly rounded upper shoulders, four visible corner bolts on front, and a small raised rectangular cream reading window near front upper-center, with a plain dark slot and NO readable digits or text. Exactly TWO vertical gray pipe connections emerge from the top corners: LEFT inlet pipe rises higher to a round silver regulator body with a dark circular cap facing FRONT, then bends left at top; RIGHT outlet pipe rises a little lower then elbows toward the rear. One small brass shutoff fitting is below the left regulator. Back of meter is plain gray with a narrow vertical seam and two mounting lugs; no duplicate reading panel or regulator on back. One thin dark mounting rail joins the rear of meter and pipe assembly. Preserve asymmetric pipe heights, regulator, elbows, ports and readings face through all five views. Overhead plan shows tops and footprint without tilted front view. Detached freestanding module, transparent alpha.
